about.title: A developer who sees the product through — not just the code
paragraphs: I'm Áron, a web developer. I don't build demos — I build systems that run in production and serve real businesses every single day.

Three things genuinely interest me: custom web applications, AI integration, and full SaaS products. The best projects start with understanding what the user actually needs — and end in a stable system that's still easy to maintain years later.
I enjoy working with SMBs and growing companies where technology genuinely matters to the business — not decoration, but a tool.
highlights: Systems that keep multiple clients' data safely separated
AI that actually takes work off your plate — not just for show
I see projects through: planning to support, and I don't vanish after launch

services.title: How I can help
services.subtitle: Not a template off the shelf — a system built around how you actually work.

items.title: Custom web applications

projects.title: What I've built so far
projects.subtitle: One live system serving real companies every day — plus a few concept demos, so you can see where I could take you.
projects.demoNote: The demo projects aren't real client work — they exist to show what I can do, before we start working on yours.

items.title: L-NYUGTA
items.summary: A cash-register companion admin dashboard and wholesale ordering system — keeps multiple companies' data safely separated, handles Hungarian NAV e-invoicing, and still serves real paying customers today.

items.title: AI customer support assistant
items.summary: An AI chatbot concept for webshops: answers common questions, looks up order status, and hands off to a human at the right moment when it's needed.

items.title: Order & inventory management SaaS concept
items.summary: An order-management and inventory system designed for small businesses — a real-time picture of what's selling, what's in stock, and what's sitting on the shelves.

items.title: Automated reporting & invoicing tool
items.summary: A concept that kills the end-of-month manual spreadsheet grind: scheduled reports, automatic exports, and the report lands in the right inbox on its own — built on export experience from L-NYUGTA.
